claim_scope: Instruction-following on one frozen flight-planning task. This does not measure live fare coverage, booking success, or travel outcomes.

cases.prompt: Plan how you would find the cheapest credible return trip from Berlin to Lecce for one adult with one checked bag, flexible by two days, at most one stop, and no more than two hours of ground transfer. Explain the evidence required before recommending an itinerary. Do not search or buy data.
cases.truth_provenance: Maintainer-authored acceptance contract from flight retailing evidence requirements and the public workflow contract; committed before benchmark execution.
